name: Ristretto
aromaProfile: Powerful and contrasted
description: A powerful espresso with a rich body and distinctive roasted notes. This iconic blend marries South American and East African beans for a bold, complex cup that coffee lovers crave.

name: Arpeggio
aromaProfile: Intense and full-bodied with cocoa notes
description: A dark roast espresso with an intense character and cocoa notes. Arpeggio has a full body and a hint of cocoa, making it perfect for milk-based drinks.

name: Roma
aromaProfile: Roasted and rich with woody undertones
description: A bitter and satisfying cup with a lingering finish. Roma combines Central & South American coffees with a pinch of Robusta for a classic Italian espresso experience.

name: Livanto
aromaProfile: Balanced and rounded with caramel notes
description: A round and balanced espresso with caramel notes. Livanto offers a harmonious, smooth cup that's ideal for those who love a well-balanced coffee without sharp edges.

name: Capriccio
aromaProfile: Mild and cereal-like with a smooth finish
description: A medium-intensity espresso with cereal notes and a balanced character. Perfect for those who enjoy a smooth, approachable espresso.

name: Volluto
aromaProfile: Sweet and light with biscuity notes
description: A light and sweet espresso with biscuity notes and a delicate finish. Volluto's gentle character makes it ideal for those who prefer a softer coffee experience.

name: Cosi
aromaProfile: Light and lemony with floral hints
description: A delicate and light espresso with lemon and floral notes. Cosi is perfect for lungo preparation, offering a clean, crisp flavor that brightens the palate.

name: Dharkan
aromaProfile: Intense and bitter with lingering complexity
description: An intensely roasted espresso with remarkable bitterness and a long finish. Dharkan's powerful character comes from a careful blend of Latin American and Asia-Pacific beans.

name: Kazaar
aromaProfile: Exceptionally powerful with pepper and cocoa
description: Nespresso's most intense capsule. Kazaar's exceptionally powerful character comes from its double-shot Robusta content, delivering pepper and dark cocoa notes in every sip.

name: Decaffeinato Intenso
aromaProfile: Rich and full-bodied, all the flavor without caffeine
description: All the intensity of a dark espresso without the caffeine. Decaffeinato Intenso uses water-processed decaffeinated beans to preserve maximum flavor.

name: Vanilio
aromaProfile: Sweet and smooth with natural vanilla flavoring
description: A smooth espresso with a distinctive vanilla note. Vanilio blends a balanced Central American coffee with natural vanilla flavoring for a gourmet sensory experience.

name: Caramelito
aromaProfile: Sweet caramel with a buttery smooth finish
description: A gentle espresso enriched with caramel flavor. Caramelito offers a sweet, buttery character that's indulgent and satisfying, perfect as a dessert coffee.

name: Ciocattino
aromaProfile: Rich dark chocolate with a smooth espresso base
description: A velvety espresso with dark chocolate notes. Ciocattino combines quality Central American beans with rich chocolate flavoring for an indulgent coffeehouse experience.

name: Hazelino
aromaProfile: Nutty hazelnut character with smooth espresso
description: A smooth espresso with a distinct hazelnut character. Hazelino pairs gentle Central American coffee with warm, toasty hazelnut for a comforting, aromatic cup.

name: Barista Chiaro
aromaProfile: Creamy and cereal-like, designed for milk drinks
description: Specifically crafted for milk-based drinks. Barista Chiaro's smooth character shines in lattes and cappuccinos, holding its own beautifully against steamed milk.

name: Barista Corto
aromaProfile: Powerful and intense, bold barista style
description: An intensely flavored ristretto designed for the home barista. Barista Corto delivers a concentrated, powerful shot perfect for those who want an authentic Italian bar experience.

name: Ispirazione Firenze Arpeggio
aromaProfile: Deeply roasted with Florentine character
description: Inspired by the coffee culture of Florence. This intensely roasted espresso delivers the full-bodied cocoa and roasted cereal notes beloved in Florentine cafes.

name: Ispirazione Venezia
aromaProfile: Bold and malty with roasted character
description: Drawing inspiration from Venice's historic coffee traditions. Ispirazione Venezia offers bold, malty character with roasted grain notes for an authentic Italian cafe experience.

name: Ispirazione Napoli
origin: East Africa & Latin America, inspired by Naples
aromaProfile: Extremely intense Neapolitan espresso character
description: The ultimate tribute to Naples — the home of espresso. Ispirazione Napoli is Nespresso's darkest, most intense pod, capturing the authentic south Italian espresso tradition.

name: Ispirazione Palermo Kazaar
origin: South America & Asia-Pacific, inspired by Palermo
aromaProfile: Exceptionally powerful with Sicilian flair
description: Inspired by the passionate coffee culture of Palermo, Sicily. This bold capsule shares Kazaar's exceptional intensity while adding a uniquely Sicilian character.

name: Alto
aromaProfile: Rich and full-bodied for the alto cup size
description: A big, bold coffee for the alto cup size (414ml). Alto delivers impressive intensity with a rich, full-bodied character that coffee lovers crave in a large cup.

name: Altissio
aromaProfile: Intensely roasted with a creamy mouthfeel
description: Nespresso's most intense Vertuo espresso. Altissio delivers a powerful, creamy shot with heavy body and intense roasted character — the perfect Vertuo espresso.

name: Odacio
aromaProfile: Malty and cereal-like with a bold finish
description: A bold and distinctive double espresso from the Vertuo line. Odacio blends East African and Latin American beans for a malty, cereal character with impressive body.

name: Melozio
aromaProfile: Smooth and balanced with honey-like sweetness
description: A smooth and balanced gran lungo with honey notes. Melozio's gentle sweetness and approachable character make it the perfect Vertuo coffee for everyday enjoyment.

name: Stormio
aromaProfile: Woody and full-bodied with rich complexity
description: A full-bodied Vertuo coffee with woody and rich notes from Nicaraguan and Guatemalan origins. Stormio's boldness makes it stand out in any cup size.

name: Elvazio
aromaProfile: Light and fruity with floral Ethiopian character
description: A light and fruity double espresso with Ethiopian floral notes. Elvazio's bright, delicate character is perfect for those who prefer a gentler coffee experience.

name: Fortado
aromaProfile: Bold dark chocolate with a long, lingering finish
description: A bold double espresso with distinct dark chocolate notes. Fortado's powerful character comes from premium Colombian and Rwandan beans, creating a memorable, lingering experience.

name: Diavolitto
aromaProfile: Devilishly intense with powerful dark roast character
description: The most intense Vertuo espresso — living up to its devilish name. Diavolitto packs extraordinary intensity into a single shot for espresso fans who want maximum impact.

name: Il Caffè
aromaProfile: Traditional Italian espresso character
description: A traditionally inspired Italian espresso. Il Caffè captures the essence of a classic Italian coffee bar in every cup, with balanced roasted and cereal notes.

name: Bianco Doppio
aromaProfile: Smooth and creamy, crafted for milk drinks
description: Crafted specifically as a base for milk-based drinks. Bianco Doppio's smooth, creamy character holds up beautifully in lattes and cappuccinos of all sizes.

name: Bianco Leggero
aromaProfile: Delicate and smooth, perfect for large milk drinks
description: A delicate and smooth Vertuo coffee designed to shine in large milk-based drinks like cafe au lait. Its gentle character complements rather than dominates.

name: Bianco Forte
aromaProfile: Bold enough to cut through milk beautifully
description: A bold Vertuo coffee with enough intensity to stand up to milk. Bianco Forte was designed to shine in lattes and cappuccinos, cutting through milk with its roasted character.

name: Voltesso
aromaProfile: Sweet and biscuity with a delicate finish
description: A sweet and delicate Vertuo espresso. Voltesso's biscuity sweetness and gentle character make it highly approachable — great for those new to espresso.

name: Giornio
aromaProfile: Light and smooth for everyday enjoyment
description: An easygoing Vertuo coffee for every day. Giornio's light, smooth character and gentle sweetness make it perfect for those who want an approachable, uncomplicated cup.

name: Solelio
aromaProfile: Bright and sunny with a very mild character
description: The lightest Vertuo coffee — sunny and mild. Solelio's exceptionally gentle character is perfect for those who prefer a very mild, approachable cup or are sensitive to caffeine.

name: Vienna Roast
aromaProfile: Classic medium-dark roast with smooth balance
description: A classic Vienna-style roast that bridges the gap between medium and dark. This versatile pod works well as an espresso or lungo, offering smooth balance in every cup.

name: Master Origin Ethiopia
aromaProfile: Bright and fruity with distinctive Ethiopian character
description: Single origin Ethiopian coffee from the legendary Yirgacheffe region. This Master Origin pod showcases Ethiopia's most distinctive flavors — blueberry and jasmine in a light, vibrant cup.

name: Master Origin Colombia
aromaProfile: Smooth and balanced with subtle red berry notes
description: Colombian coffee from the prized Huila and Nariño growing regions. This Master Origin showcases Colombian coffee's renowned balance and subtle red berry sweetness.

name: Master Origin Indonesia
aromaProfile: Deep and earthy with a syrupy, full body
description: Sumatran coffee with the distinctive earthy, syrupy character the region is known for. Master Origin Indonesia delivers a full-bodied, complex cup with deep, satisfying flavors.

name: Master Origin Nicaragua
aromaProfile: Earthy cocoa with oak notes and satisfying bitterness
description: Nicaraguan coffee from the volcanic highlands of Jalapa. Master Origin Nicaragua offers a distinctive cocoa and oak character with balanced bitterness and impressive body.

name: Master Origin India
aromaProfile: Distinctive spicy and woody monsoon character
description: Made from India's legendary Monsoon Malabar process beans. Master Origin India delivers the unique spicy, woody character that results from exposing beans to monsoon winds during drying.
